cycle_year.label: NHANES examination cycle start year
cycle_year.medical_context: Captures secular changes in population composition, clinical practice, and measurement procedures; it is not a biological attribute caused by an individual.
semantic_constraints: No individual-level treatment, outcome, biomarker, behavior, or diagnosis can cause the survey cycle.

RIDAGEYR.label: Age in years at screening
RIDAGEYR.coding: 0-79 years; age 80 or older is top-coded at 80
RIDAGEYR.medical_context: Age strongly influences cardiometabolic disease, prescribing, treatment response, blood pressure, and lipid levels.
semantic_constraints: Current treatment, current outcome, disease status, and behavior cannot cause chronological age.

RIAGENDR.label: Sex recorded by NHANES
RIAGENDR.medical_context: Sex is associated with body composition, cardiovascular risk, prescribing, and treatment response.
semantic_constraints: Variables measured in this study cannot causally determine recorded sex.

RIDRETH3.label: Race and Hispanic-origin category with non-Hispanic Asian category
RIDRETH3.coding: NHANES categories for Mexican American, other Hispanic, non-Hispanic White, Black, Asian, and other/multiracial
RIDRETH3.medical_context: A social-demographic marker associated with structural, socioeconomic, access-to-care, and health differences; it is not a manipulable biological treatment.
semantic_constraints: Current treatment, outcome, biomarker, and behavior cannot cause this recorded category.

DMDEDUC2.label: Highest education level among adults aged 20 years or older
DMDEDUC2.timing: mostly established before current treatment assessment
DMDEDUC2.coding: 1 less than ninth grade through 5 college graduate or above
DMDEDUC2.medical_context: Education can affect health literacy, access to care, medication adherence, diet, and long-term cardiometabolic risk.
semantic_constraints: The current examination outcome cannot directly cause previously completed education.

DMDMARTL.label: Current marital status
DMDMARTL.coding: married, widowed, divorced, separated, never married, or living with partner
DMDMARTL.medical_context: May proxy social support, household structure, health behavior, and care access; reverse effects from long-term illness are possible.
semantic_constraints: Do not force a direct medical direction when the association is likely socioeconomic or confounded.

INDFMPIR.label: Ratio of family income to the federal poverty threshold
INDFMPIR.coding: continuous ratio, commonly top-coded by NHANES
INDFMPIR.medical_context: Proxies material resources, insurance and care access, diet, adherence, and chronic disease risk; long-term illness may also reduce income.
semantic_constraints: Current same-visit biomarkers should not be treated as unambiguous direct causes of family income.

RIDEXMON.label: Six-month period of examination
RIDEXMON.medical_context: Can capture seasonal effects on activity, diet, physiology, and measurement; it is assigned by examination timing.
semantic_constraints: Individual health variables cannot cause the calendar period in which NHANES scheduled the examination.

BMXBMI.label: Body mass index
BMXBMI.coding: kg/m^2, derived from measured weight and standing height
BMXBMI.medical_context: A deterministic function of weight and height and a marker of adiposity associated with hypertension, diabetes, lipids, and prescribing.
semantic_constraints: Weight and height determine BMI by formula; BMI should not be used as the direct cause of its own component measurements without explicit justification.

BMXWAIST.label: Waist circumference
BMXWAIST.medical_context: Marker of central adiposity and metabolic risk; may affect hypertension, diabetes, lipid levels, and treatment assignment through clinical risk.
semantic_constraints: A same-visit blood pressure or cholesterol measurement does not instantaneously cause waist circumference.

BMXWT.label: Measured body weight
BMXWT.medical_context: Reflects body size and adiposity and contributes directly to BMI; related to cardiometabolic risk and prescribing.
semantic_constraints: Weight and height mathematically determine BMI.

BMXHT.label: Measured standing height
BMXHT.medical_context: Adult height is largely predetermined and contributes to BMI scaling; age-related shrinkage is possible but current medication or outcome cannot plausibly determine it.
semantic_constraints: Current antihypertensive or cholesterol medication, current blood pressure, and current cholesterol cannot cause adult standing height.

BPXPLS.label: Sixty-second pulse rate
BPXPLS.medical_context: Reflects autonomic and cardiovascular state; can be affected by fitness, disease, and some medications, and can predict blood pressure outcomes.
semantic_constraints: Contemporaneous association with blood pressure does not by itself establish a direct causal direction.

LBXGH.label: Glycohemoglobin (HbA1c)
LBXGH.medical_context: Reflects average glycemia over roughly the preceding two to three months and marks diabetes severity and cardiometabolic risk.
semantic_constraints: A same-day outcome measurement cannot cause the preceding-month glycemic history represented by HbA1c.

DIQ010.label: Doctor told participant they have diabetes
DIQ010.coding: 1 yes; 2 no; borderline responses handled separately by NHANES
DIQ010.medical_context: Historical diabetes diagnosis can affect medication, care intensity, cardiovascular risk, and current metabolic outcomes.
semantic_constraints: Current examination biomarkers may reflect diabetes but do not retroactively cause the historical fact of a prior diagnosis.

DIQ050.label: Currently taking insulin
DIQ050.causal_role: concurrent co-treatment and diabetes severity proxy
DIQ050.medical_context: Proxies diabetes treatment and severity; it may affect HbA1c and cardiovascular risk and may share prescribing determinants with the study treatment.
semantic_constraints: Treat as a co-treatment/severity marker, not as a disease diagnosis itself.

BPQ020.label: Ever told by a health professional that participant had hypertension
BPQ020.medical_context: All included participants have BPQ020=1, so this node contains no within-cohort information and should not enter graph learning or adjustment.
semantic_constraints: In the antihypertensive-SBP cohort this variable is fixed to yes and is not an informative graph node.

BPQ080.label: Ever told by a health professional that blood cholesterol was high
BPQ080.medical_context: Prior high-cholesterol diagnosis influences lipid-lowering treatment and indicates cardiometabolic risk.
semantic_constraints: In the cholesterol-medication cohort this variable is fixed to yes and is excluded from candidate nodes.

MCQ160B.label: Ever told participant had congestive heart failure
MCQ160B.medical_context: A major cardiovascular comorbidity that may affect prescribing, blood pressure, activity, and prognosis.
semantic_constraints: Current examination outcomes do not retroactively cause the recorded history of diagnosis.

MCQ160C.label: Ever told participant had coronary heart disease
MCQ160C.medical_context: Indicates established atherosclerotic disease and can strongly affect preventive medication decisions and risk.
semantic_constraints: Current treatment use may be a response to this prior disease history, not its cause in the study time ordering.

MCQ160E.label: Ever told participant had a heart attack
MCQ160E.medical_context: Prior myocardial infarction strongly affects lipid-lowering and blood-pressure treatment decisions and future cardiovascular risk.
semantic_constraints: Current medication status in this cross-sectional study should not be treated as the cause of a prior heart attack.

MCQ160F.label: Ever told participant had a stroke
MCQ160F.medical_context: Prior stroke can affect antihypertensive and lipid-lowering treatment, activity, disability, and subsequent risk.
semantic_constraints: Current medication status should not be treated as the cause of a stroke that occurred before the survey.

MCQ220.label: Ever told participant had cancer or a malignancy
MCQ220.medical_context: Cancer history may influence body composition, care patterns, medication decisions, and current health but is not necessarily a direct cardiometabolic cause.
semantic_constraints: Prefer no direct edge when only nonspecific comorbidity association is plausible.

SMQ020.label: Smoked at least 100 cigarettes in lifetime
SMQ020.medical_context: A cumulative smoking-history marker associated with cardiovascular disease, treatment assignment, and outcomes.
semantic_constraints: Current blood pressure or cholesterol cannot cause whether the lifetime threshold had already been reached.

PAQ605.label: Vigorous-intensity activity at work
PAQ605.timing: typical current-week behavior reported at interview
PAQ605.medical_context: Work activity may affect fitness and cardiometabolic risk, while disease and socioeconomic factors can affect ability to perform it.
semantic_constraints: Allow reverse causation from chronic illness or functional limitation; use UNRESOLVED if timing is not identifiable.

PAQ620.label: Number of days of vigorous-intensity work activity in a typical week
PAQ620.timing: typical current-week behavior reported at interview
PAQ620.coding: days per week among participants reporting vigorous work activity
PAQ620.medical_context: Quantifies frequency conditional on participation in vigorous work activity and is structurally downstream of whether such activity is performed.
semantic_constraints: PAQ605 eligibility/participation logically precedes the conditional frequency PAQ620.

PAQ635.label: Walking or bicycling for transportation
PAQ635.timing: typical current-week behavior reported at interview
PAQ635.medical_context: Active transport contributes to physical activity and is influenced by health, environment, occupation, and socioeconomic factors.
semantic_constraints: Do not infer a direct edge from association alone when built environment or health status may confound it.

PAQ650.label: Vigorous recreational activity
PAQ650.timing: typical current-week behavior reported at interview
PAQ650.medical_context: May improve cardiometabolic health; chronic illness and functional capacity can also determine participation.
semantic_constraints: Bidirectional long-term relations with health are possible; distinguish current measurement timing from underlying disease history.

PAQ665.label: Moderate recreational activity
PAQ665.timing: typical current-week behavior reported at interview
PAQ665.medical_context: May improve cardiometabolic health, but underlying health and access can determine participation.
semantic_constraints: Use UNRESOLVED when cross-sectional timing cannot separate behavior-to-health from health-to-behavior.

PAD680.label: Minutes of sedentary activity on a typical day
PAD680.timing: typical current-day behavior reported at interview
PAD680.medical_context: Sedentary time is related to cardiometabolic risk and can be influenced by occupation, disability, illness, and other activity patterns.
semantic_constraints: Vigorous work participation can reduce available sedentary time, but both can share occupational causes.

T.label: Currently taking prescribed antihypertensive medicine
T.timing: current medication use initiated before the MEC blood-pressure measurement
T.coding: 1 currently taking prescribed medicine; 0 not currently taking, among participants with BPQ020=1
T.medical_context: Medication is prescribed in response to prior hypertension severity and cardiovascular risk and is intended to lower current systolic blood pressure.
semantic_constraints: For the target intervention, T may cause Y; current Y must not be oriented as the cause of already initiated T.
Historical disease severity may cause both T and Y and represents confounding by indication.

Y.label: Mean systolic blood pressure
Y.timing: MEC examination after current medication status was reported
Y.coding: mean of available systolic readings in mmHg
Y.medical_context: Arterial pressure during cardiac contraction; lower values generally indicate better blood-pressure control in this cohort.
semantic_constraints: Y is the terminal outcome for local uplift discovery and cannot cause predetermined baseline attributes.
T -> Y is fixed by the intervention query.
